touristAppeal.label: Local detour
touristAppeal.summary: Llangernyw qualifies as a local detour through Amgueddfa Syr Henry Jones Museum and Two Cross-Incised Stones in St Digain's Churchyard, Llangernyw. It is best treated as a shorter stop rather than a half-day destination.
